# Cosimo by Medici & Company

> Cosimo gives financial operations teams more capacity by taking on recurring work using their own records, procedures and reporting formats.

## Product

Cosimo is an AI agent for financial operations from Medici & Company. It brings source records through agreed preparation, checks and calculations into reports, review packages and follow-ups. The method is saved for subsequent runs with new inputs. The team resolves exceptions, retains professional sign-off and updates the process when requirements change. Principal examples are daily loan reviews for banks and investor reporting for funds; insurance and administration, accounting and advisory firms use the same approach for their recurring work.

## Examples and claim boundaries

The website examples use fictional records and prewritten outputs, not live product runs or customer results. Source links open sample records. The examples do not establish measured time savings, integration coverage, audit readiness, security certification, or guaranteed turnaround. Process-specific configuration and testing are required. The team retains review and approval.

## Start with one process

Email info@medici.ai with what your team prepares, where the information comes from, and which part takes the most time. Medici & Company works through a first process to test with the team. Scope and commercial terms are agreed before starting; evaluation starts with one task and one period of source files under NDA, written feasibility confirmation, and a review of the run and its sources. Model usage is charged at cost without markup; platform terms are agreed in conversation.

Website: https://cosimo.work

## Actions and approvals

Cosimo can prepare work and perform supported actions through connected accounts. Sending to other people and editing or deleting existing material require individual approval. Some actions confined to the user’s own account can be allowed on an ongoing basis. The specific connection, operation and approval requirements are established during setup.
